title: CORE Parametric Cache Entry v1
description: Schema for a parametric cache entry that stores the compiled command structure (skeleton) from a resolved template+binding pair. Caches ONLY the structural/route/shape information -- never live results, state events, or permissions.

template_id.description: Reference to the source parametric template.

template_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the source template.

binding_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical binding values (sorted by slot name). Identifies which variable set produced this shape.

resolved_slots.description: The fully resolved slot name-to-value map after binding.

compiled_shape.description: The compiled structural shape of the command. Contains NO live data -- only the command skeleton.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds. 0 = no expiry (structure is stable).

max_entries_per_template.description: Maximum cache entries per template_id before eviction.

eviction_policy.description: Eviction strategy when max_entries_per_template is reached.

forbidden_categories_cached.description: Categories explicitly confirmed as NOT cached. Must match the template's forbidden_categories.

live_data_excluded.description: Must be true. Confirms no live data is present in this cache entry.
